description: Power user tool to target an exact node in the SQLite history graph and forcibly overwrite its text content, completely pruning out incorrect details or debug junk.

commit_id.description: The exact commit ID in the memory graph to overwrite

kept_chunks.description: Optional list of verified permanent facts to retain

new_summary.description: New summary text replacing the original reason log

prune_transient.description: If true, automatically deletes all transient logs and discarded chunks for this node (default: true)

name: override_memory_node
